newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TABLE TENNIS-GATIEN EUROPEAN TOP 12 CHAMPION.
newsitem.headline: TABLE TENNIS-GATIEN EUROPEAN TOP 12 CHAMPION.

text.p: Jean-Philippe Gatien of France and Luxembourg's Ni Xia Lian took the honours at the European Top 12 table tennis tournament in Eindhoven on Sunday.

Gatien, world champion in 1993, beat Vladimir Samsonov of Belarus in a tight five game final while Ni Xia, undefeated in the round-robin stage of the tournament, dropped the first game to Germany's Jie Schopp before pulling away to win easily.

The Frenchman lost his first two group matches and seemed in danger of elimination before finding his form. He defeated Jan-Ove Waldner of Sweden, seven times winner of the event, in the semifinals after another five-game battle.
Chinese-born Ni Xia looked dominant throughout the tournament, losing just four games in seven matches as she cruised to her second successive Top 12 title.
